note: ROOM 25's PROOF SPEC. Pratt's claim is reached only with the Company's map in hand -- next door from Prosperity, or on the map (errata 97 C) -- which no route can give, so the proof starts from fixture r25-a (Act I, the map in hand) and says so; the doors pass walks the way next door. The principal change is his offer: every conversation ends with one (doc 04).

principalChange.note: PRATT_OFFERS (doc 04: 'Every single conversation, regardless of topic, ends with Pratt making an offer'). Visible consequence: TALK TO him and leave, and he names his price.
